title: veve's Soil
description: Giving dirt the colour it deserves! Polytone required
body:
[![Button to join vevetable's Discord server](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/061b7cfc70a1d7daa274911fd63a32c5b940b95c.png)](https://discord.com/invite/qDpgxvHH5n)

## Description


**Inspired by** the unique colourmapped soil of **[Caelesti](https://modrinth.com/project/4sznRHpx)**,

and **with the help** of the **[Polytone](https://modrinth.com/project/3qAYkBMB) mod**,

I sought to give _vanilla dirt_ some **new colours**!


## Features

![Eleven biomes lined up in a wide shot, showing each different colour of soil for each type of biome.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/96ef9dea1aec349382e5f6fc8893a825461db816_0.webp)

- **All** types of dirt blocks have biome dependant colour changes!

- Soil colours are grayer at low Y levels, and brighter above cloud level. (no pictures yet, sorry)

- Path blocks dead grass colour now changes with the biomes grass colour.

- Farmland blocks show moisture on the sides.

See the [gallery](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/veves-soil/gallery) for examples!



## Compatabilities

**THIS IS CURRENTLY IN BETA, VEVE'S SOIL IS UNTESTED WITH OTHER PACKS!!** 

This is being developed on Fabric 1.21.8-1.21.11 using the latest version of Polytone, no other Minecraft versions are tested yet!

<details>
<summary>Known Bugs</summary>

- Rendering artifacts on close up Grass Blocks when using Anisotropic Filtering, especially with high Mipmap levels (inconclusive but likely polytone).

_Send bug reports to my Discord Server!_
</details>

<details>
<summary>Planned Features</summary>
  
- Add variant textures to break up grid patterns, including all different dirt block types _and_ their pebbles.

- Diagnose (and fix) bugs.

_Let me know what else you want to be added in my Discord Server!_
</details>

If you would like to give a suggestion, feedback, or bug report, head over to my Discord server!
